items.name: footer-001
items.title: Подвал на фоне страницы
items.description: Подвал без собственной плиты: фон и палитра берутся у страницы. Подпись бренда, три колонки ссылок и нижняя строка с юридическим. Тёмная плита в конце спорила бы с финальной секцией призыва.
items.docs: Блок самодостаточен: один файл, без зависимостей, собственная палитра в локальных переменных --vibeui-footer-001-*. Раскладка считается от собственной ширины блока: две колонки ссылок, затем три, затем бренд уходит в отдельную колонку слева. Каждая группа ссылок — <nav> со своей подписью, поэтому скринридер перечисляет их отдельно, а не как одну кашу из двадцати ссылок.

ai.usage:
<Footer001
  brand="Полёт"
  columns={[{ title: "Продукт", links: [{ label: "Тарифы", href: "/pricing" }] }]}
  legal="© 2026 Студия «Полёт»"
/>
ai.summary: Подвал сайта: слева знак, название и одна фраза о продукте, справа колонки ссылок, внизу копирайт и юридические ссылки. Светлый намеренно — тёмный подвал сразу после тёмной секции призыва даёт два тяжёлых пятна подряд. Ноль зависимостей, один файл, своя палитра, клиентского JS нет.

en.description: A footer without a slab of its own: background and palette come from the page. Brand line, three link columns and a legal row. A dark slab here would fight the closing call-to-action.
en.docs: The block is self-contained: one file, no dependencies, its own palette in local --vibeui-footer-001-* variables. The layout is computed from the block's own width: two columns of links, then three, then the brand moves into a separate column on the left. Each link group is a <nav> with its own label, so a screen reader lists them separately rather than as one undifferentiated run of twenty links.

ai.summary: A site footer: the mark, name and a single line about the product on the left, link columns on the right, copyright and legal links along the bottom. Light on purpose — a dark footer right after a dark CTA gives two heavy blocks in a row. Zero dependencies, one file, its own palette, no client JS.

The copyright year is deliberately static text rather than a Date call. Update it along with the rest of the copy.
Do not lift the CSS variables into globals.css: the block has to stay a single file.

en.description: A dark four-column footer: every link group is its own navigation with a label, and the bottom row carries a live service-status line.
en.docs: The block is self-contained: one file, no dependencies, its own palette in local --vibeui-footer-002-* variables. A server component. Each link group is a separate <nav> with an aria-label, otherwise a screen reader reads twenty links in a row as one undifferentiated run. The layout is computed from the block's own width: two columns, then four, then the brand moves into a separate column on the left. The dot on the status line pulses through box-shadow in keyframes and is switched off under prefers-reduced-motion.

ai.summary: A dark footer: the mark, the name and a sentence about the product on the left, four columns of links on the right, and a bottom row with the copyright and a status link with a pulsing dot. Zero dependencies, one file, its own palette, no client JS.

the status line in the bottom row: people come down to the footer for it when something is broken
the dot pulsing through box-shadow rather than size: a size change would nudge the text next to it
the prefers-reduced-motion rule — the pulse has to switch off

the container queries on the column count: in a narrow column the footer has to fold on its own
the <style> block inside the component — it holds the palette, the columns and the pulse
the dark ground as the design idea of the block: this footer is deliberately single-toned, it has no light branch, so light-dark() never appears in its palette

background — the footer ground; empty keeps the block's own dark slab

The footer stays dark in every theme: that is the design of the block. The background prop can retint the slab, but not make it light — the text and links assume a dark ground.
Do not link to a status page you do not have: the promise gets tested at the first outage.
More than four links per column push the footer past a phone's first screen — move rare ones to a sitemap.
The mark is masked out of the background: with a very dark accent it merges into the ground.
Do not lift the CSS variables into globals.css: the block has to stay a single file.

  columns={[{ title: "Product", links: [{ label: "Pricing", href: "/pricing" }] }]}

items.name: footer-003
items.title: Подвал с подпиской
items.description: Подвал с подпиской: форма занимает верхний ряд целиком, у поля видимая подпись, рядом честное согласие, а колонки ссылок идут под ней.
items.docs: Блок самодостаточен: один файл, без зависимостей, собственная палитра в локальных переменных --vibeui-footer-003-*. Серверный компонент: поле неуправляемое, форма отправляется обычным POST и работает до гидратации. Форма поставлена в верхний ряд и отделена чертой: если подписка нужна бизнесу, она не должна ютиться сбоку от ссылок. Подпись поля видимая и связана через htmlFor, а не спрятана в placeholder. От 46rem форма делится на две колонки, а поле с кнопкой встают в один ряд.

/>

en.description: A footer with a signup: the form takes the whole top row, the field has a visible label, honest consent sits next to it, and the link columns run below.
en.docs: The block is self-contained: one file, no dependencies, its own palette in local --vibeui-footer-003-* variables. A server component: the field is uncontrolled, the form is submitted by a plain POST and works before hydration. The form is placed in the top row and set off by a rule: if the business needs the subscription, it must not be squeezed in beside the links. The field label is visible and tied through htmlFor rather than hidden in the placeholder. From 46rem the form splits into two columns and the field and the button stand in one row.

ai.summary: A newsletter footer: a heading, an explanation and a form with a visible field label and a consent line on top, then four columns of links and a copyright row. The form is real and works without client code. Zero dependencies, one file, its own palette.

items.description: Минимальный подвал в одну строку: бренд, копирайт, три служебные ссылки и «наверх». Для коротких страниц, где четыре колонки выглядят чужой деталью.

items.docs: Блок самодостаточен: один файл, без зависимостей, собственная палитра в локальных переменных --vibeui-footer-008-*. Серверный компонент. Реквизиты размечены списком определений <dl>: это пары «что это — значение», и скринридер обязан читать их парами, а не сплошной строкой цифр. Числовые значения набраны tabular-nums, поэтому колонка цифр не пляшет. Настройки cookie вынесены отдельной ссылкой в нижнем ряду: по регламентам согласие должно отзываться так же просто, как давалось, и прятать эту ссылку в тексте нельзя.

  legalLinks={[{ label: "Публичная оферта", href: "/offer" }]}
/>

en.description: A legal footer: registration details as a definition list, required documents in their own navigation, a disclaimer and a separate cookie-settings link.
en.docs: The block is self-contained: one file, no dependencies, its own palette in local --vibeui-footer-008-* variables. A server component. The registration details are marked up as a definition list, <dl>: they are “what it is — value” pairs, and a screen reader has to read them as pairs rather than as a continuous string of digits. Numeric values are set in tabular-nums, so the column of figures does not dance. The cookie settings are pulled out as a separate link in the bottom row: the regulations require consent to be as simple to withdraw as it was to give, and this link must not be buried in the text.

items.name: footer-009
items.title: Мега-подвал с подпиской
items.description: Мега-подвал: строка подписки на рассылку сверху, карта сайта в пять колонок и нижний ряд с копирайтом и соцссылками. Самодостаточен: один файл, без зависимостей.
items.docs: Блок самодостаточен: один файл, без зависимостей, собственная палитра в локальных переменных --vibeui-footer-009-*. Серверный компонент, клиентского JS нет. Строка подписки стоит первой: до подвала доходят самые вовлечённые посетители, и форма здесь конвертирует лучше, чем в середине страницы. Каждая колонка карты сайта — отдельный <nav> со своей подписью, иначе скринридер читает тридцать ссылок одной кашей. Колонки раскрываются от 2 до 5 по собственной ширине блока через container queries, поэтому в узкой врезке блок честно показывает мобильную раскладку.

en.title: Mega Footer
en.description: A mega footer: a newsletter row on top, a five-column sitemap and a bottom row with the copyright and social links. Self-contained: one file, no dependencies.
en.docs: The block is self-contained: one file, no dependencies, its own palette in local --vibeui-footer-009-* variables. A server component with no client JS. The newsletter row comes first: the most engaged visitors are the ones who reach the footer, and the form converts better here than in the middle of the page. Each sitemap column is its own <nav> with a label — otherwise a screen reader reads thirty links as one mush. The columns expand from 2 to 5 based on the block's own width via container queries, so in a narrow slot the block honestly shows the mobile layout.

en.title: Big Wordmark Footer
en.description: A footer with a giant translucent wordmark: link columns on top, the brand name across the full width below them, cropped by the bottom edge. Self-contained: one file, no dependencies.
en.docs: The block is self-contained: one file, no dependencies, its own palette in local --vibeui-footer-010-* variables. A server component. The wordmark is hidden from screen readers: the brand name is already in the copyright.

items.title: Подвал с переключателями
items.description: Подвал с панелью настроек региона: колонки ссылок плюс селекты языка и валюты и декоративный переключатель темы. Самодостаточен: один файл, без зависимостей.
items.docs: Блок самодостаточен: один файл, без зависимостей, собственная палитра в локальных переменных --vibeui-footer-011-*. Серверный компонент: селекты — нативные <select> и работают без JS, переключатель темы декоративный, логику вешает проект. Свои выпадашки ломают клавиатуру и мобильные пикеры ради косметики, поэтому селекты нативные, а стрелка нарисована двумя градиентами — appearance:none убирает браузерную, и без своей селект выглядит обычным полем. Панель настроек собрана в правой колонке отдельной карточкой с тёплым тинтом из акцента: там её ищут по привычке из крупных магазинов.

en.title: Call-to-Action Footer
en.description: A footer with a CTA panel: a warm plate with a heading and an orange button on top, regular link columns and the copyright below. Self-contained: one file, no dependencies.
en.docs: The block is self-contained: one file, no dependencies, its own palette in local --vibeui-footer-015-* variables. A server component. The CTA panel sits in the footer on purpose: this is the last screen, and a visitor who scrolled this far has already read the arguments — they need a button, not one more benefit. The panel's warm tint and border are mixed from the accent via color-mix, so changing accent recolours the panel by itself. The secondary action is a link, not a second button: two equal calls cancel each other out. Each link column is its own <nav> with a label.

ai.summary: A call-to-action footer: a warm CTA panel with a heading, a note, an orange button and a secondary link on top, four link columns and the copyright below. Zero dependencies, one file, its own palette, no client JS.
preserve: the local --vibeui-footer-015-* palette — do not swap it for your theme tokens
the CTA panel first: this is the last screen, the visitor who scrolled here needs a button, not one more benefit
the brand-orange button fill with near-black text on it — the contrast of this pair is calculated
the panel's warm tint and border mixed from the accent via color-mix — it recolours together with accent
the secondary action as a link, not a second button: two equal calls cancel each other out
each column as its own <nav> with a label — otherwise a screen reader reads all the links as one mush
the panel's two-column layout only from 56rem of the block's own width
the <style> block inside the component — it holds the palette, the panel and the layout
light-dark() in the palette: the component has to follow the surrounding color-scheme rather than ship a dark theme of its own
the transparent ground by default — the footer sits on the page background instead of laying a panel under itself
adapt: ctaTitle and ctaNote — the heading and the note of the call
ctaButtonLabel and ctaHref — the button label and address
ctaSecondaryLabel and ctaSecondaryHref — the secondary link
the columns array — the link columns, their labels and addresses
copyright — the copyright line
accent and background — the button and panel accent and the ground; an empty background means the page colour
notes: The theme comes from color-scheme. For the component to darken with the system, the project must declare color-scheme: light dark on html — otherwise light-dark() always returns the light branch.
The button and links point at placeholder anchors — put the real signup and catalog addresses in.
In a narrow slot the actions drop below the panel text — by design, do not fix it.
Do not lift the CSS variables into globals.css: the block has to stay a single file.
